comparison.objective: Install an O-ring over a hydraulic plug thread into its groove without excessive stretch or twist.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled elastomer stretching, axial transfer over threads, square release, and seating correction.
comparison.success_condition: Ring is fully seated and released in the groove, remains within the 50% stretch and 90° roll limits, and has no side left on the thread; damage limits force zero.
comparison.reason: The record tests deformable seal handling and damage avoidance, whereas the candidate tests coupled rigid screw/nut adjustment and retained articulated function.
